page_note: Page contains a major chapter boundary. Segments 0-7 conclude a previous kephalaion using ecclesial application — "Second Living Man dwelling in the holy Church", persecution rhetoric drawing analogy to the cosmic First Man's struggle, "twelve doctrines", "their holy Father". After heavy lacunae, a new chapter (Kephalaion 15) opens with title "Concerning the five [Greatnesses]" (seg 10) and proceeds, after a brief apostolic dialogue formula (seg 12), into a clean and systematic enumeration of the Five Greatnesses: First (Father of Greatness, in silence and concealment), Second (Mother of Life, Great Spirit), Third (Great Builder, Living Spirit + five sons), Fourth (Third Ambassador with Pillar of Glory and powers of light), Fifth (Jesus the Radiance with his emanations). This is canonical substrate cosmological enumeration — pure five-fold mapping, both sides internal to the cosmic system. Editorial fatigue score is strongly negative (-3.46), confirming late material concentrates in the first half (closing the prior kephalaion) and the new kephalaion is dominantly substrate.
